page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90-lssd is a memory-optimized and storage-intensive server instance powered by the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9B14 processor. It features 90 dedicated vCPUs across 45 physical cores with multithreading enabled, paired with 720 GB of system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB memory-to-core ratio. The hardware configuration includes 3216 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across 8 local drives, providing high-speed local data access without a discrete GPU.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates top-tier multi-core performance, placing in the top 10% for stress-ng multi-core tests, PassMark CPU scores, and software compilation tasks. Its cryptographic capabilities are also highly rated, supported by hardware-accelerated instruction sets such as AES, VAES, and SHA_NI. Memory performance is strong, with read-only bandwidth reaching up to 6368.24 GB/sec for cached small blocks and maintaining 217.31 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, though large block write bandwidth sits in the average tier at 77.28 GB/sec.

The inclusion of 3.2 TB of local NVMe SSD storage combined with high memory capacity makes this instance highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring dense local scratch space and large in-memory datasets, avoiding the network latency and cost of external block storage. It is highly suited for large-scale database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, heavy software compilation, and medium-scale language model prompt processing.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90-lssd is a memory-optimized and storage-intensive server configuration designed for demanding enterprise workloads. Powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor, it delivers 90 dedicated vCPUs across 45 physical cores and 720 GB of RAM, establishing an 8.0 GB per-core memory ratio. The instance integrates 3216 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 8 drives, offering high-speed local I/O. In performance benchmarks, it achieves top-tier results in multi-core CPU execution, software compilation, and cryptographic operations, alongside strong database and Redis transaction throughput. While single-threaded performance and large-block memory write speeds are moderate, its massive memory footprint and bundled high-speed local storage provide excellent resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for data-intensive applications. This server is highly suited for large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, and parallelized software build pipelines.
